d.ko:
Do you have what it takes to become an astronaut?

Reentry is a realistic space flight simulator inspired by the early NASA space programs, from orbiting Earth in Mercury and Gemini, to the moon landing in project Apollo.

Learn the procedures. Operate the spacecraft. Complete the mission.
